messages:
carmen: Strange one — our Expo sample started crashing only after a quick edit (fast refresh). Error: `crypto.getRandomValues is not a function` from inside the SDK's retry code. Full reload is fine. Anyone seen a hot-reload-only RN crypto failure?

leo: Yup. Usually a race where Metro resolves the CJS `main` that expects Node globals while the RN polyfill (react-native-get-random-values) hasn’t been applied yet during the module re-eval. Fast refresh can re-run modules out of order.

zahra: Are you shipping a dedicated RN entry in package.json? If not Metro will pick the main/cjs file. A minimal fix: add "react-native": "./dist/rn/index.js" in exports or a root-level "react-native" field that points to an RN file which imports polyfills first.

carmen: We only had main/module entries. We do import the polyfill in App.tsx but apparently the SDK module runs earlier on hot-swap.

sam: Two practical approaches: 1) publish a tiny RN bundle that immediately runs `import 'react-native-get-random-values'` and then re-exports the SDK; 2) include a synchronous guard in that RN entry like `if (!globalThis.crypto) require('react-native-get-random-values')` so repeated fast-refresh evals are safe.

leo: Also watch TS consumers: if your d.ts is `export =` shape, users need esModuleInterop; better to ship ESM types with `export default` and use conditional exports in package.json so modern TS picks the ESM path. Example: "exports": {".":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs.js","react-native":"./dist/rn/index.js"}}.

zahra: Small dev trick: add a tiny `rn/setup.js` that sets `globalThis.__redwood_rn = true` after applying polyfills so hot reloads don't rewrap fetch/interceptors. Also ensure the RN entry attaches auth/retry interceptors synchronously (not lazily) to avoid a temporal hole where a request fires with no auth header.

carmen: I'll add an RN export and a setup file that imports the polyfill + attaches fetch wrapper sync. Will also update sample README with a note to import the RN path directly if using older Expo/Metro.

devex-bot: CI: expo-managed fast-refresh job showed flakes related to sample onboarding. Creating ticket #1012.

sam: thanks — ping when PR is up and I’ll do a quick review.
